label: Wallet transaction quest
summary: Reward a clearly defined wallet action using finality-aware, replay-safe chain evidence.
requiredFacts: Exact qualifying chain, action, contract, event, amount and time window
Wallet identity for EOAs, ERC-1271 accounts and delegated or sponsored execution
Confirmation depth, reorg handling, replay key and one-time claim rule
Sybil limits, payout cap and privacy expectations
requiredTests: EOA, smart-account and sponsored transaction attribution
Duplicate event, replay, reorg and wrong-chain rejection
risks: Transaction sender may not equal the intended user
Reorgs or duplicate indexing can pay twice
Public wallet activity can expose user behavior
